prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a production game-texture projection source, a painted version of the FIRST input guide. Output exactly 1024 x 1024 with actual transparent RGBA background.
Input roles: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry/registration authority, a white orthographic render of the exact model. Image 2 is the approved design_reference.png and is the colour/material authority ONLY. Any additional image is a supporting top-view geometry reference, never the target view.
CRITICAL: Paint only the existing surfaces in image 1. Preserve its alpha silhouette, every protrusion and notch, its exact position and occupied size, every part boundary, occlusion and orthographic viewpoint. Preserve the entire 1024 square canvas and its large transparent margins. Do not enlarge, recenter, rotate, straighten, reinterpret or repair the model. Do not use the outline or camera from image 2. Return one view only, no contact sheet.
Subject: the Hesper Voice Splinter relic implant. Apply the approved reference's ivory-white ceramic casing with subtle fine wear, warm brushed gold structural web/rims and connector prongs, dark black-violet amethyst/crystal or resin exposed in the web openings, and fine branching orange light fissures in the crystal. Connector light insets are orange with pale bright centres. Follow existing sculpted divisions to place those materials; crystal remains very dark purple with subdued violet planar differences and fine fracture texture; ceramic is softly warm ivory with delicate wear lines; metal is its warm gold base colour with only a faint sheen. Unseen surfaces plausibly continue the SAME casing, gold framing and dark purple crystal. No extra materials or attachments.
LIGHTING IS ALBEDO: completely even, flat, shadowless illumination from the viewer. Remove the guide's baked shading and shadows while retaining its geometry through colour boundaries. No cast shadows, no contact shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional light gradients, no bright specular spots, no reflections, no rim light. Render gold as base gold pigment, not shiny rendered metal. Glowing fissures and insets are painted bright orange/pale light-colour lines only, without bloom or light spilling onto other parts or transparent background. No background, floor, scenery, text, letters, symbols, labels, watermark, UI, or border.
VIEW-SPECIFIC INVARIANTS:
FRONT guide: keep the wide, horizontally foreshortened end view in the middle of the square. Overall alpha bounds are x=183..840, y=335..688. The three existing raised narrow connector/teardrop forms are across the middle, facing the viewer: preserve all three at their original exact locations and shapes, with gold surfaces and orange inset centres. The surrounding casing is ivory ceramic with gold framing; exposed angular crystal at the far upper edge uses black-violet crystal. Do not turn it into the upright diagonal design-reference view.
reason: Selected for closer guide silhouette among the two attempts. The return is 1254 x 1254, preserved byte-for-byte and unresized as instructed. Exact guide silhouette and fully shadowless albedo checks remain unmet; faint stray alpha is present outside the main object. One permitted corrective regeneration exhausted.
